task.text:
[0] RNAi-mediated reduction in sgg expression using two independent dsRNA-expressing transgenes significantly increased lifespan (Fig. S2F). RNAi-mediated knockdown of sgg resulted in resistance to phenobarbital and paraquat.

[1] Human GSK3 presents in two isoforms GSK3a and GSK3b, while the fly ortholog of GSK-3, is only Shaggy (Sgg). Ubiquitous overexpression of wild-type sgg significantly shortened lifespan ин 30%, Fig 2C.

[2] Human GSK3 presents in two isoforms GSK3a and GSK3b, while the fly ortholog of GSK-3, is only Shaggy (Sgg). RNAi-mediated reduction in sgg expression using two independent dsRNA-expressing transgenes significantly increased lifespan (Figures 2D and S2F).

[3] Ubiquitous overexpression of constitutively active Sgg (SggS9A) significantly reduced lifespan by 50% (fig. S2E).

[4] RNAi-mediated reduction in sgg expression using two independent dsRNA-expressing transgenes significantly increased lifespan (Fig. S2F). RNAi-mediated knockdown of sgg resulted in resistance to phenobarbital and paraquat.

Each numbered passage describes one lifespan experiment. For each, report three things using ONLY that passage:
  organism: the model organism studied, one lowercase word
  direction: exactly one of 'increases lifespan', 'decreases lifespan', or 'no change'
  method: how the gene was altered, e.g. gene knockout, overexpression, mutation, knockdown

Output one block per passage, in order, formatted exactly:
[0]
organism: ...
direction: ...
method: ...

Nothing else. If a passage does not state something, write 'unstated'.
